zh.title: 民航局：選舉疏運期間離島部分航班近滿訂
zh.summary: 民航局指選舉疏運期間離島部分航班近滿訂，建議返鄉民眾善用海運。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，為因應地方公職人員選舉期間離島民眾返鄉投票需求，已協調航空公司規劃航班及加開班機。離島航線目前訂位踴躍，部分日期及時段的航班已近滿訂。
選舉疏運期間為11月27日至30日，國內航線共提供1,010架次、73,864個座位，其中澎湖、金門及馬祖航線合計提供68,590個座位。
民航局提醒有返鄉需求的民眾，可利用海運船班，彈性安排往返行程。民航局也將持續掌握各航線訂位情形，並視旅運需求協調航空公司適時調整運能。

en.title: Taiwan CAA says some island flights nearly booked for election period
en.summary: Taiwan CAA says some island flights are nearly booked during the election period and suggests sea travel.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration said it had coordinated with airlines to plan flights and add services in response to demand from residents travelling home to outlying islands to vote in local elections. Bookings on island routes have been strong, with flights nearly fully booked on certain dates and at certain times.

During the November 27–30 election travel period, domestic routes offer 1,010 flights and 73,864 seats, the administration said. Routes serving Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu account for a combined 68,590 seats.

The administration advised people travelling home to consider sea services when arranging their journeys. It said it would continue monitoring reservations across routes and coordinate capacity adjustments with airlines as needed, based on travel demand.
